highlights.full: Shows a recommendation when at least two flights have usable data, the leader is ahead by eight points or more, and the tracker has medium or high confidence. If those checks fail, WiFi Odds says it cannot pick a winner.
Marks per-flight next-gen odds and airline-wide ConnectScore as different numbers, so you can tell whether the estimate describes your flight or the airline.
On supported United and Alaska result pages, moves flights with better next-gen odds higher. Keep site order puts the rows back where the booking site placed them.

allowedFeatureClaims.title: Flight labels
allowedFeatureClaims.question: Does this number describe the flight or the airline?
allowedFeatureClaims.ceiling: WiFi Odds shows per-flight odds for a United or Alaska flight number when the booking site provides one. Other recognised airlines get an airline-wide ConnectScore label.
steps: Add the CONNECTSCORE label when needed

behaviors.united: Shows per-flight next-gen odds on United rows and the airline-wide ConnectScore.
behaviors.alaska: Shows per-flight next-gen odds on Alaska rows after you grant site access.
behaviors.navan: Shows per-flight odds on United rows. Other airlines get an airline-wide score or stay unknown.
behaviors.google: Shows airline-wide scores. United and Alaska rows can get per-flight odds when Google shows the flight number.

allowedFeatureClaims.title: Best WiFi choice
allowedFeatureClaims.question: Does one flight have enough support for a recommendation?
allowedFeatureClaims.ceiling: WiFi Odds recommends a flight after it finds at least two scored options, an eight-point lead, and medium or high tracker confidence.
steps: Find flights that can be compared
Recommend one flight or explain why it cannot

behaviors.united: Shows a Best WiFi choice when enough United flights pass the recommendation checks.
behaviors.alaska: Shows a Best WiFi choice when enough Alaska flights pass the recommendation checks.
behaviors.navan: Can move a supported United flight higher while keeping unscored rows in their original order.
behaviors.google: Shows labels without moving Google’s results or adding a Best WiFi choice button.

allowedFeatureClaims.title: Automatic sorting
allowedFeatureClaims.question: Can WiFi Odds move higher-odds flights and put the page back?
allowedFeatureClaims.ceiling: United and Alaska single-airline result pages can sort by next-gen odds. Keep site order restores the booking site’s order.
steps: Restore the saved order on undo

behaviors.united: Sorts supported United result lists and offers Keep site order.
behaviors.alaska: Sorts supported Alaska result lists and offers Keep site order.
behaviors.navan: Keeps Navan’s order because some airlines do not have per-flight scores.
behaviors.google: Not offered here. Google Flights controls the result order.

allowedFeatureClaims.title: Route summary
allowedFeatureClaims.question: Does this page have enough flight data for a route summary?
allowedFeatureClaims.ceiling: The summary uses flights shown on the page and says which ones have scores. Flights without scores stay in place.
steps: Read the flights on the page

behaviors.united: Shows a route summary of the visible United flights and their per-flight evidence.
behaviors.alaska: Shows a route summary after you grant Alaska site access.
behaviors.navan: Summarises United rows and marks other airlines as unscored.
behaviors.google: Not offered here. Google Flights gets labels on each row instead.

allowedFeatureClaims.title: Trip Guardian
allowedFeatureClaims.question: Has the airline assigned a different aircraft?
allowedFeatureClaims.ceiling: Trip Guardian reports the latest aircraft assignment it can verify. If the airline has not published an aircraft, it says the assignment is unknown.
steps: Add the flight to Trip Guardian
Read the airline’s published tail number
Show the update and its source

behaviors.united: Checks a saved United flight for an aircraft assignment update.
behaviors.alaska: Checks a saved Alaska flight after you grant Alaska site access.
behaviors.navan: Watches a supported United flight saved from Navan.
behaviors.google: Checks a supported flight saved from Google Flights without changing Google’s order.

allowedFeatureClaims.title: Extension popup
allowedFeatureClaims.question: Does the extension have access to this booking site?
allowedFeatureClaims.ceiling: The popup shows which booking sites you have enabled and lets you look up airline-wide WiFi scores.

behaviors.united: United access comes with the extension. The popup shows current coverage and lookup.
behaviors.alaska: The popup lets you turn Alaska access on, then shows Alaska coverage.
behaviors.navan: Navan access comes with the extension. The popup explains that per-flight odds cover United rows.
behaviors.google: The popup lets you turn Google Flights access on, then shows airline-wide scores.
